label: Oil OLTC
explainer: On-load tap changer (OLTC): it changes transformer taps while the transformer is energised. These types put the switching arc in oil, inside a separate oil compartment.

label: Vacuum OLTC
explainer: Vacuum OLTC: same job as an oil OLTC, but the arc is inside a vacuum interrupter, not in the oil. Use when the buyer wants less oil carbon and longer contact life.

label: Dry-type OLTC
explainer: Air-insulated OLTC for dry-type transformers. Not for oil tanks.

label: Gas-insulated OLTC
explainer: OLTC built for SF6 gas-insulated regulating transformers.
shopCategory: On-Load Tap Changer / Gas Insulated Type

label: Regulator OLTC
explainer: OLTC used on a distribution step-voltage regulator, not on a power-transformer tank.

label: Reactive OLTC
explainer: Compartment OLTC that uses reactor (reactive) transition. Common on North American units. Not the same as the resistive in-tank oil or vacuum types.

label: Cage OCTC
explainer: De-energized tap changer (OCTC / DETC): only operate it when the transformer is isolated. Cage type sits in the tank oil with no separate oil compartment. This is not an OLTC.

label: Drum OCTC
explainer: De-energized drum tap changer. Often one single-phase drum plus one two-phase drum. Not an OLTC.

label: Linear OCTC
explainer: De-energized linear tap changer. Usually three single-phase units linked and driven from one side mechanism. Not an OLTC.

label: Motor drive unit
explainer: Motor drive unit (MDU): the motor box that turns the tap changer. It is an accessory, not a tap changer. HWV already includes its drive — do not add CMA7 a second time on that type.

label: Controller and monitor
explainer: Remote controllers, automatic voltage regulators, position indicators, and online monitors. They talk to an MDU. They are not tap changers.

label: Online oil filter
explainer: A cabinet that filters oil and particles from the tap-changer oil compartment. Not needed on HWV under normal conditions (vacuum switching, no oil carbon).

label: Other accessory
explainer: Shop items that are not a tap changer, MDU, monitor, or filter. Function is only what the local sources state.
